meta.name: geo-optimizer
meta.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — make content rank in AI search answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Audits existing content, rewrites for AI citation, and produces per-engine strategy. Use when asked to "optimize for AI search", "rank in ChatGPT", "GEO audit", "improve AI citations", "rank in Perplexity", "AI Overview optimization", "AI Overview ranking", "LLM SEO", "answer engine optimization", "AEO", "get cited by AI", "GEO", "generative engine optimization", "show up in ChatGPT", "appear in AI answers", "be cited by Perplexity", "SGE optimization", "Search Generative Experience", or "make my content show up in AI answers". Distinct from regular SEO — this targets generative engines, not traditional Google rankings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 这个技能会分析你的内容，评估它在AI搜索（如ChatGPT、Perplexity等）中被引用的可能性，并给出优化建议或直接重写内容，以提高被AI引用的概率。
howto.when: 当你要求优化AI搜索排名、进行GEO审计、或让内容出现在ChatGPT等AI回答中时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这篇博客的GEO得分。
say.note: 技能会分析内容并给出评分和改进建议。

say.text: 优化这段文字，让它更容易被ChatGPT引用。
say.note: 技能会重写内容，增加数据、引用等。

say.text: 为我的网站制定一个GEO策略。
say.note: 技能会生成30/60/90天的优化计划。

howto.what_en: This skill analyzes your content, evaluates its likelihood of being cited by AI search engines (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity), and provides optimization suggestions or rewrites to increase AI citation probability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to optimize for AI search, perform a GEO audit, or make content appear in AI answers like ChatGPT.

say_en.text: Audit this blog post for GEO score.
say_en.note: The skill will analyze and give a score with fixes.

say_en.text: Rewrite this text to be more citeable by ChatGPT.
say_en.note: The skill will add data, citations, etc.

say_en.text: Create a GEO strategy for my website.
say_en.note: The skill will produce a 30/60/90 day plan.
